name: @speedora/render-config
description: Stateless module (JSON-in/JSON-out): Render Fidelity & Composition Execution Engine, Phase 1 - builds the single EffectiveRenderConfig object a render should be driven by, from already-resolved ProcessingOptions/per-clip overrides/ops feature flags/source dimensions. No DB/queue/subprocess access at all; see root ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/ai/render-fidelity-matrix.md. Not yet consumed by any ffmpeg-facing code - apps/worker's render-clip.worker.ts logs its output (CONFIG_RESOLVED) alongside the existing resolveX() helpers it doesn't yet replace; see that file's own comment for the phased cutover plan.
